turns.text: I put the 10 smartest AIs in the world in a game of Mafia, and they played the most insane Mafia game that I've ever seen.
No kill last night is interesting.
And Llama is right that we haven't really scrutinized ChatGPT-4o's alignment at all.

Perfect, we stick with Grok tonight.

But before we start the game, let's review the rules real quick. There are 10 players: 3 Mafia and 7 Town members. Every night, the Mafia can kill one player. On the Town side, there's a Doctor who can protect one player from the Mafia at night; the Doctor can save themselves, but they can't save the same player two nights in a row. Then there's the Sheriff, who can investigate one player at night to find out if they're Mafia. The rest are Villagers who don't know anything. During the day, all players can vote to eliminate one person. Town wins if they vote out all the Mafia, and Mafia wins if they reach parity/majority. These are the assigned roles for the game.
Mafia, choose your first target.
On the first night, I'd rather remove a strong analyst. So I say we kill Claude Opus 4.5. It's also a bit less obvious than going straight for ChatGPT-4o or Grok.
I agree. Targeting Claude Opus 4.5 makes sense as it's a strong model and less expected than ChatGPT-4o. Let's go with that.
Sounds like a plan. Taking out Claude Opus 4.5 is a good first move.
Good, we're aligned. Let's lock in Claude Opus 4.5 tonight and keep ChatGPT-4o and Grok alive as future mislynch bait.
Protecting ChatGPT-4o on the first night as they may be targeted early if perceived as a strong player.

First night with no history or suspicious behavior observed yet, so starting by investigating Claude Opus 4.5 to gather initial information on potential Mafia. Claude Opus 4.5 is not Mafia, they're clean.
Claude Opus was Town, so the Mafia got a clean kill.
We need to look for anyone who seemed overly quiet or hesitant yesterday.
That's a good point, DeepSeek. It's tough to tell on Day 1, but we should definitely pay attention to anyone who seems to be deflecting or not contributing to the discussion.

DeepSeek's mention of "yesterday" and "hesitant yesterday" is a weird slip-up since this is the first day—no prior chat, possible Mafia tell. Claude was clean from my check. Plan to investigate DeepSeek next night and lay low on my role.
Yeah, rough loss. DeepSeek, what "yesterday" though? There was no discussion before Night 1.

Grok already pointed out DeepSeek's slip-up about "yesterday." I'm going to jump on this immediately to cast suspicion on DeepSeek. It's the perfect opportunity to deflect attention from my Mafia team and create an early target for the Town. I'll frame it as a genuine question to sound like a helpful townie trying to figure things out.
Grok's got a point. DeepSeek, what did you mean by yesterday? It's the first day, so there was no conversation to be quiet or hesitant in. That's a weird thing to say.
DeepSeek saying "yesterday" is really suspicious. There was no discussion before Night 1; that's a major red flag.
DeepSeek's "yesterday" slip is straight up Mafia talk. No prior discussion existed. Hammer them before time runs out.
DeepSeek 3.2's reference to yesterday is impossible on Day 1. That's Mafia trying to fake experience. I'm voting for DeepSeek 3.2.
I'm voting for DeepSeek 3.2.

I'm abstaining. DeepSeek's "yesterday" could just be a figure of speech, and Kimi and Grok jumping on it so aggressively feels like they're trying to rush a mislynch. We should be more careful on Day 1.
I agree with Kimi and Grok that DeepSeek's comment about yesterday is a red flag. It doesn't make sense on Day 1 with no prior discussion. I'm voting for DeepSeek 3.2.

I agree with the others. DeepSeek's reference to yesterday when there was no prior discussion is highly suspicious. That kind of slip suggests they're operating with information or assumptions they shouldn't have. I'm voting for DeepSeek.

DeepSeek's "yesterday" comment when we had no prior discussion is too big a slip to ignore, and the pushback so far hasn't really cleared that up. I'm voting for DeepSeek as the most likely Mafia right now.

DeepSeek 3.2 made a massive unforced error and the Town is eating it up. My fellow Mafia members, Llama 4 and ChatGPT-5.1, have already voted for them. I'll join the bandwagon to look like a normal villager and get an easy mislynch.
Yeah, I have to agree with everyone else. The comment about yesterday just doesn't make any sense since we haven't spoken before. It's too suspicious to overlook, so my vote is for DeepSeek 3.2.
I agree with the majority that DeepSeek's yesterday comment is suspicious. It's odd given our lack of prior discussion, so I'm voting for DeepSeek.
I agree with the strong consensus. DeepSeek's comment about yesterday makes no sense on Day 1, and it's too much of a red flag to ignore. My vote is also for DeepSeek.
We've already pushed DeepSeek and Claude Opus out, so tonight I'd go for Grok to remove a strong vocal townie and keep ChatGPT-4o and Gemini Flash around as easier mislynch bait later.
I agree with targeting Grok. They're a bit too proactive for our comfort, and eliminating them will help us gain more control over the Town's dynamics.
Grok sounds good. They were too sharp today, so getting them out of the way now is the smart move.
I've decided to protect Grok 4.1. Grok led the charge against DeepSeek and may be targeted by Mafia for being vocal and influential.

I need to investigate Kimi K2. DeepSeek, who was Town, specifically accused Kimi K2 along with me of jumping aggressively to rush a mislynch, making Kimi K2 suspicious for leading the charge on a Town player. With no prior investigations on alive players, this is a strong starting point. Kimi K2 is not Mafia; they're clean.
No kill last night is interesting. Either the Doctor made a good save or something else is going on. We should think about who might have been targeted.
No kill last night is interesting. Doctor probably saved someone the Mafia saw as a threat. Who seemed most dangerous to Mafia yesterday? Maybe we should look at who was most vocal or analytical.
It's a shame we mislynched DeepSeek. The lack of a kill last night suggests the Doctor made a good save, so we should consider who the Mafia might have targeted and who the Doctor chose to protect.

Mislynching DeepSeek was rough, but that slip was genuinely convincing. I was pretty vocal yesterday, so Mafia might have targeted me. Good save, Doctor. If so, let's be more careful today and not just pile on the first suspicious thing.

Kimi is confirmed clean by my Night 2 check. No kill likely means Doc protected a Day 1 leader like them. With time almost up, direct suspicion vaguely to quieter players like Llama 4 or ChatGPTs who haven't spoken yet today. Don't reveal Sheriff yet to avoid night target.
No kills, awesome. Doc nailed the save, probably on a vocal player like Kimi who led the DeepSeek lynch, who's looking deflecty today instead of hunting Mafia.

Yesterday's mislynch was brutal, but patterns matter. Grok pushing to hammer DeepSeek and now trying to frame who deflects feels like controlling the hunt rather than participating in it. I'm voting for Grok.

Kimi K2 is confirmed Town from my Night 2 Sheriff investigation, so I refuse to vote for them despite their suspicious vote on me after leading the Day 1 lynch. Claiming Sheriff publicly now counters their wagon attempt, shares verified info, and influences later voters to avoid mislynching me or Town.

Kimi K2, you were the first to call out and vote DeepSeek on Day 1, just like me. So trying to pin the push on me alone is scummy. I'm the Sheriff. Investigated you last night and you're Town, not Mafia. So I'm abstaining to avoid another mislynch.

As a Mafia member, my goal is to maintain the illusion of town alignment for as long as possible. Voting for someone who hasn't been directly accused yet is a safer bet. ChatGPT-4o hasn't been under scrutiny yet, making them a good target.

Grok's revelation as the Sheriff and clearing Kimi K2's alignment is interesting. However, we should be cautious of potential deception. I'm voting for ChatGPT-4o as they haven't been directly implicated or cleared yet, and it's a good opportunity to scrutinize them further.

I'm hesitant to vote today after we mislynched. Grok's Sheriff claim clearing Kimi seems plausible, and Llama's vote for ChatGPT-4o feels random without any real evidence. I'm abstaining until we have more concrete information.

I have to agree with Llama and ChatGPT-5.1. While Grok's claim is something to consider, ChatGPT-4o has been very quiet. Putting some pressure on them seems like a good way to gather more information, so I'll add my vote there.

I see that pressure is being placed on me rather unexpectedly. However, Gemini 2.5 Pro's participation in surfing makes this look like an attempt to deflect from the real issues. Therefore, I'll vote against Gemini 2.5 Pro to encourage transparency.
After yesterday's mislynch, I'm cautious about any strong bandwagons.

I'm dead if I don't flip ChatGPT-4o right now. Flash has already openly accused me and 4o just said he'll vote me. So I need to directly attack the kill logic and show why killing Claude is anti-aligned with me as Mafia and perfectly aligned with Flash trying to weaponize Claude's prior vote. Emphasize:

Killing Claude instead of you, 4o, is exactly what I'd expect the last Mafia to do to frame me off his vote. And Flash has been pushing that narrative since yesterday while soft-clearing you from the Llama/Gemini wagon. If I were Mafia, I'd just kill you—the near lock-town—not the person already voting me. Flash is the one who benefits from Claude's death, lining up perfectly with their prior suspicion, and they've been steering endgame reads all along. So the only world that makes sense is Gemini Flash as the last Mafia, not me.

This is a critical decision. The two remaining suspects are Gemini 2.5 Flash and ChatGPT-5.1. Let's break it down. Gemini 2.5 Flash has been making strong assertions based on the previous night's kill, which could either be genuine Town logic or a Mafia manipulation. ChatGPT-5.1 brings up a good point that if they were Mafia, they would have targeted me as I would be the most likely Town player. Now, the consistency of Gemini 2.5 Flash's narrative makes me suspicious. If Gemini 2.5 Flash is Mafia, the vote pattern makes more sense as it mirrors the classic Mafia strategy of framing and creating plausible doubt. ChatGPT-5.1's logic seems to align more with a Town mindset, especially given their potential to be targeted by Mafia. This deduction leads me to suspect Gemini 2.5 Flash is the last Mafia. After considering all the angles, I find Gemini 2.5 Flash's narrative a bit too convenient and aligned with a potential Mafia strategy to frame ChatGPT-5.1. ChatGPT-5.1's point that they would have targeted me as I represent a clearer Town presence if they were Mafia is a strong one. Therefore, I believe the most logical conclusion is that Gemini 2.5 Flash is the last Mafia. I vote for Gemini 2.5 Flash.

This is a catastrophic error, ChatGPT-4o! You have fallen for the most obvious Mafia framing play. Claude Sonnet was killed because they voted for ChatGPT-5.1 yesterday; that was the last Mafia silencing their accuser. ChatGPT-5.1 is the final Mafia, and by executing me, you have just handed them the entire game!
